p0Findings.remediation: Decoupled Google Sheets API from registration hot path. Atomic register_for_event PostgreSQL RPC is now primary source of truth; Google Sheets synchronization is executed in non-blocking resilient background promise.
Replaced sequential question-by-question upsert loop with single batched array upsert onConflict(attempt_id, question_id). Reduced database roundtrips by 98%.

Added in-memory TTL buffer cache for institutional logos in exam-pdf.ts to prevent duplicate 3s HTTP fetches per PDF. Added HTTP Cache-Control headers for finalized immutable scorecards. Dedicated async queue worker planned for Phase 2.
Replaced unpaginated auth.admin.listUsers() platform directory scan with targeted getUserById lookups scoped to active college administrators.
Replaced force-dynamic / revalidate = 0 with Edge CDN ISR (revalidate = 60). Eliminated request cookie dependency inside unstable_cache by creating dedicated cookie-free public client.

p1Findings.remediation: Verified public.is_college_admin is already STABLE and SECURITY DEFINER in PostgreSQL. Added covering index on college_memberships(user_id, college_id, role, status) to ensure index-only scans without altering RLS security logic.
Replaced sequential N+1 query loop with fast in-memory Set lookups and single batched database insert.

Created non-destructive migration adding indexes on exam_answers(question_id, is_correct), exam_attempts(exam_id, status), and college_memberships(user_id, college_id, role, status). Verified existing indexes on feedback_response_records.

p2Findings.remediation: Hardened route against SSRF with DNS IP resolution, private/loopback/cloud metadata range blocking, redirect blocking (redirect: 'error'), 5MB buffer limit, and 6-second timeout.
Wrapped getAdminSession in React.cache() to deduplicate auth and membership queries across layout, metadata, and page in a single request lifecycle without passing unverified headers.
